name: Expanded Defaults
author: sykesthelord
description: Adds default-app pickers (file manager, image viewer, PDF viewer, media player, mail client) and priority-ranked default device submenus (cameras, sound outputs, microphones) to the Omarchy start menu's Defaults section. This entry only tracks the install for update/remove -- the actual functionality is a menu JSONC extension, backend scripts, and a systemd --user watcher, installed by running ./install.sh from this repo, not a bar widget.
